acceptanceCriteria: Root cause identified and fixed in code or test with a regression case covering a symlinked TMPDIR ancestor.
The macos-15 full-gate leg passes this test in a hosted run, with the run id retained.
body: Observed in the release-gates nightly run 38052349384 (main 1b35c6a8, 2026-10-10, macos-15 full-gate leg). cmd/corvint/index_snapshot_test.go:568 expects legacy_left to be empty after the sweep; on the hosted runner it names a path under /private/var/folders. Likely the same symlinked-TMPDIR class as V1-0960 (/var -> /private/var), but unconfirmed. Blocks a green nightly full gate for 1.0.0-rc.3 (decision 0491 cut).
title: TestIndexReceiptNamesTheSweptLegacyStore fails on hosted macos-15: legacy_left is a non-empty /private/var/folders path
